grades.quote: The result of the floating-point comparison will be written into the condition flag register. When the comparison result is true, it is set to `1` , otherwise it is set to `0` .
grades.reason: Provides auxiliary information about comparison-result flags, but does not explain ordered/unordered conditions, NaNs, or exception behavior.
Describes RISC-V double-precision comparisons, not the required LoongArch FCMP conditions.
